title: App idea seed
description: The app ideas Mynt ships (workspaces/coding-build/templates/ideas.seed.json). They live in Postgres (financial_products.app_ideas) once an admin runs seed_app_ideas, which adds the missing ones and never overwrites a row already there. src/app-ideas.ts checks what this schema can't say: the kind exists, the lines are the kind's and ones Mynt builds on in the US, and the text promises nothing Mynt can't build.

kind.description: The app kind it builds on (templates/kinds/<kind>.json)

problem.description: The label: who has the problem and what it is, in plain words

pitch.description: One line: what the app does about the problem

goal.description: The goal the build starts from, which the developer edits

sort.description: Order within the kind, lowest first
